sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is alleged to be the husband as per the complaint.
The applicant is disputing his status as husband.
However, ends of justice would be served in case the applicant is permitted to appear before the court concerned and his bail application is considered.
He submits that directly Non-Bailable Warrant has been issued against the applicant.

Non-Bailable Warrant could not have been issued against the applicant directly by the court concerned as firstly Bailable Warrant ought to have been issued and in the present case, even the summons have been served.

sentences.text:
Be that as it may, since the learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is ready to appear before the court concerned, the applicant may appear before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024.
5.

In the event, the applicant files surrender application before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024 and also file bail application, the court concerned shall decide the surrender application along with bail application after serving an advance copy to the Public Prosecutor within seven days.
6. Till 2.4.2024, the Non-Bailable Warrant and proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. shall be kept in abeyance.
In case the applicant appears before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024, the Non-Bailable Warrant and proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. shall not be executed in future.

7. In the event of non-appearance of the applicant before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024,
the court concerned would be at liberty to proceed with the Non-Bailable Warrant and proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. in accordance with law.
8. Subject to the aforesaid directions/observations, the present application stands disposed of.

opennyai_summary.arguments: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is alleged to be the husband as per the complaint.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The applicant is disputing his status as husband.
Non-Bailable Warrant could not have been issued against the applicant directly by the court concerned as firstly Bailable Warrant ought to have been issued and in the present case, even the summons have been served.
opennyai_summary.decision:
However, ends of justice would be served in case the applicant is permitted to appear before the court concerned and his bail application is considered.
Be that as it may, since the learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is ready to appear before the court concerned, the applicant may appear before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024.
5.
In the event, the applicant files surrender application before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024 and also file bail application, the court concerned shall decide the surrender application along with bail application after serving an advance copy to the Public Prosecutor within seven days.
6. Till 2.4.2024, the Non-Bailable Warrant and proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. shall be kept in abeyance.
In case the applicant appears before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024, the Non-Bailable Warrant and proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. shall not be executed in future.
7. In the event of non-appearance of the applicant before the court concerned on or before 2.4.2024,
the court concerned would be at liberty to proceed with the Non-Bailable Warrant and proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. in accordance with law.
8. Subject to the aforesaid directions/observations, the present application stands disposed of.
